# ECO360

> The compliance and carbon data layer for physical products. Product-level CO₂,
> substance screening and digital product passports. Every figure carries a
> confidence tier. Operated by Eco360 Ltd, Finland.

## What ECO360 does
- Product carbon footprints at model level, with the calculation tier stated
- Bill-of-materials screening for PFAS, REACH SVHC and RoHS (TSCA and Prop 65 in scope; not_applicable for EEA-market products)
- Supplier material declarations: IEC 62474 and IPC-1752A import with official-schema validation (export not yet available)
- Digital Product Passport data
- GHG Scope 1/2/3 reporting from the same loaded data
- Delivered as an API, a console, an embeddable product card, or an agent
- PACT Conformant: WBCSD PACT Technical Specifications V3.0 data exchange, official conformance testing tool, November 2026
